title: Finite quotients of full surface braid groups and complex surfaces of general type: cyclic, dihedral, and extra-special quotients
summary: Let $\mathsf{B}_2(Σ_g)$ be the full braid group on two strings on a compact Riemann surface of genus $g$. We compute the number of finite cyclic, dihedral and extra-special quotients $\varphi \colon \mathsf{B}_2(Σ_g) \to G$, under the assumption that the quotient map $\varphi$ does not factor through $π_1(\operatorname{Sym^2}Σ_g)$. We then apply our algebraic results to the geometric problem of constructing smooth surfaces of general type as Galois covers of $\operatorname{Sym^2}(Σ_g)$ branched on the diagonal.
